light.boxShadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px

dark.boxShadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px

light.backgroundImage: linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255, 255, 255), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0))

dark.backgroundImage: linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255, 255, 255), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0))
